# Hepatitis B evaluation for patients receiving Anti-CD20 Antibody Treatment

**Omaha Guidance:**

RECOMMENDATIONS NOT AVAILABLE
Recommendations for this condition are not available within CDSS. Please refer to facility guidelines or other clinical resources for recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

# NOTE: OUTPATIENT ORDERS

Before initiating anti-CD20 antibody treatment (rituximab, obinutuzumab, ofatumumab) test all patients for Hepatitis B. Testing should be completed within the last 6 months prior to the start of the initial infusion (same day is acceptable, but not preferred). Annual Hepatitis B screening is not necessary unless there are risk factors.

# More information at VHA Oncology SharePoint site for hepatitis B reactivation:

Hepatitis B Oncology SharePoint

# Order Hepatitis B Serology Panel for all patients:

HEPATITIS B SEROLOGY PANEL

Includes hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), anti-hepatitis B core antibody (total anti-HBcAb),and anti-hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBsAb).

# IF HBsAg or anti-HBcAb is positive, Consult GI for all services except

# Oncology:

(Includes Rheumatology, Renal, Neurology, and Dermatology)

GASTROENTEROLOGY LIVER OUTPATIENT CONSULT

# IF HBsAg or anti-HBcAB is positive for an ONCOLOGY patient initial orders:

a) Assess HIV status. To avoid potential HIV resistance-refer HIV positive patients to ID for management.

HIV RAPID TEST (results in 1-2 hours)

CONSULT ID FOR HIV POSITIVE PATIENTS
b) Obtain Labs: Comprehensive Metabolic AND Phosphorus

ORDER LABS: COMPREHENSIVE METABOLIC + PHOSPHORUS
c) Obtain HBV DNA level (viral load) initially

HEPATITIS B DNA LEVEL (VIRAL LOAD)
d) Schedule GI Clinic Consult for co-management to order liver imaging and follow-up as indicated.

GASTROENTEROLOGY LIVER OUTPATIENT CONSULT
e) Start hepatitis B antiviral treatment (see below)

Therapy:
**Minneapolis Guidance:**

## Recommended Antiviral Treatment:

Continue antivirals throughout anti-CD20 Ab therapy and for an additional 12 months to prevent hepatitis B reactivation, hepatitis, liver failure, and death.

## Obtain HBV DNA level (viral load) every 3 months

Hepatitis B DNA level (viral load)

## IF PATIENT IS CURRENTLY ON HEPATITIS B ANTIVIRAL THERAPY:

(lamivudine, adefovir, or telbivudine)

Consult the provider who ordered the antiviral and inform the provider the patient is being initiated on Anti-CD20 antibody therapy.

## IF PATIENT IS NOT ON HEPATITIS B ANTIVIRAL THERAPY:

## Lamivudine-naive patients:

Entecavir 0.5 mg po daily (throughout anti-CD20 antibody therapy
and for an additional 12 months after therapy completed). (Cost $$) [R,O]

## Lamivudine-experienced patients:

## Preferred Treatment:

Entecavir 1 mg po daily (througout anti-CD20 antibody therapy
and for an additional 12 months after therapy completed). (Cost $$) [R,O]

< OR >

## Alternative Treatment:

IF creatinine clearance equal to or greater than 50 ml per minute

Tenofovir 300 mg PO daily (throughout anti-CD20 antibody therapy
and for an additional 12 months after therapy completed). (Cost $$) [R,O]
